GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2022-01-28T12:21:32Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: EXPLAIN SYNTAX doesn't report more than one column in GROUP BY
Description: For instance a query like this:

```sql
explain syntax (SELECT sum(number) _number, count(), number, toDate(now()) date FROM numbers(10) GROUP BY number, date);

EXPLAIN SYNTAX
SELECT
    sum(number) AS _number,
    count(),
    number,
    toDate(now()) AS date
FROM numbers(10)
GROUP BY
    number,
    date

Query id: 985a47d6-644e-4821-8a6d-83de0925cfdd

┌─explain─────────────────────┐
│ SELECT                      │
│     sum(number) AS _number, │
│     count(),                │
│     number,                 │
│     toDate(now()) AS date   │
│ FROM numbers(10)            │
│ GROUP BY number             │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

should report: `GROUP BY number, date` in the last line.

Tested on these versions with the same result: 20.7.2.30, 21.7.4.18, 21.9.5.16, 21.12.3.32, 22.1.2.2

I'll analyze this GitHub issue about the EXPLAIN SYNTAX not reporting all columns in GROUP BY.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is a documentation/reporting issue in ClickHouse's EXPLAIN SYNTAX functionality. The problem is clearly demonstrated in the provided example where the SQL query includes "GROUP BY number, date" but the EXPLAIN SYNTAX output only shows "GROUP BY number", omitting the second column. This is purely a display/reporting issue in the EXPLAIN SYNTAX feature.

To verify the solution to this issue, one would only need to check if an updated version of ClickHouse correctly displays both columns in the GROUP BY clause when using EXPLAIN SYNTAX. This can be done through code analysis or by reviewing the fix implementation. The issue doesn't require building or running code to understand the problem or verify a solution - it's a straightforward case where the output doesn't match the input query structure. The solution would involve fixing how the EXPLAIN SYNTAX feature formats and displays GROUP BY clauses with multiple columns.
